name: Speechmark Open Graph social card by Speechmark
description: The card is essentially the app icon enlarged: a warm off-white macOS-style squircle floats on a full-bleed near-black field, carrying a single oversized opening-quote glyph optically centred slightly above the tile's middle. There is no headline, wordmark or URL — focal hierarchy comes entirely from the scale jump between one glyph and the surrounding negative space, plus the cream-on-black luminance contrast. A faint top-to-bottom sheen on the tile makes it read as a physical icon, and the strict two-value palette keeps it legible even at thumbnail size.
